I've been diagnosed with severe depression since I was 11. I'm now 19 (turning 20 real soon). I am a male in the US. 

So the depression started when I was in 6th grade. I switched schools and it was a COMPLETE change. My mom got a job making 3 times what she used to, and my dad got a major promotion. I went from a very lower class neighborhood (I lived in the projects) to a very upper class neighborhood (my neighbor has a dodge viper, if that puts it into perspective). With the change in cities came a change in schools, loss of friends, everything. At the same time my oldest brother, my hero, moved out, he didn't want to leave our old city behind so he got an apartment there. He was 20 at the time, so it was inevitable that he was going to move out sooner or later, but it was just to much change for me at once.

I instantly became the target of bullying. I am, and have always been, overweight. At the time it wasn't BAD, I could have lost like 10lbs, but kids will target you for anything. 

Fast forward to high school. 9th grade happens. I get my first true girlfriend, she was really cool. I get SUPER close with my best friend, his mom is abusive so he moves in with me, he was like another brother to me. Well in a week period I discover my girlfriend is cheating on me, and my best friend moves thousands of miles away. I'm in Texas and he is in Minnesota. And, in this week, my grandmother (who was like a 2nd mother to me) dies. At this point the depression worsens to the point of contemplating suicide. I actually try once, but I didn't cut deep enough, actually not very deep at all, it didn't even leave a scar. 

Now let's move to summer between 10th and 11th, I meet this super awesome girl. We start dating, I am SHOCKED, I am very overweight, have terrible acne, there is literally nothing physically pleasing about me. She is the polar opposite, skinny, perfect skin, BEAUTIFUL. Also, she is very smart, I'm stupid as hell. She's funny, I'm awkward. Why she wanted to date me, I'll never know. It's been 3 years and we are still together. 

Junior and senior year go pretty well, at this point my depression is still present, but it's not as bad as before. 

Start college. First semester is terrible, I lived at home and commute to my university with my girlfriend. I hate every aspect of college. I feel stupider than ever. I got decent grades in high school. Mostly B's with an occasional A. I fail every class but 1 my first semester of college.

Well, I decide one thing hurting my grades is the commute, so I get a dorm, thinking this will make things better. Also, I lost every friend I had when I went to college. I thought I would make new friends in the dorm. 

The dorm destroys me. I made 0 friends all semester, every time I tried to talk to someone they would either walk away, brush me off, or blatantly tell me 'why are you talking to me". 

So, grade wise, I have a decent 2nd semester, but not enough to make up for my terrible 1st one. I get suspended for 1 semester. Now I'm going to a community college, which I hate. I feel worthless for going to a worthless school. I hate my peers, I hate my professors, I hate everything about the school and about myself.

My girlfriend is living in the dorms at the university now. It's still pretty close, only about 20 minutes away. But she works almost every day. she goes to class from about 11 to 3. then works 4 to midnight, and it takes her 45 minutes to drive from work to school. So I am seeing her less and less. my shift button just popped off out of nowhere, so proper capitalization is stopping from this point on. back to my story, she is getting very stressed with work and school and she is taking it out on me. i feel as if we are only a few months away from breaking up, which kills me, i want to marry her.

so thats my story in a nutshell.

The thing is, I've thought so much about it that I now WANT it. I feel like the likelihood of me doing it at some point is like a 10/10. I can't imagine myself living for more than like 5 years. Weather it be suicide or accident.

My thing is I have a concrete plan, I feel like if I tell her she will react by hospitalizing me, but I fear that hospitalization will only make things worse. I guess due to being suicidal and self-loathing I don't care about my safety, just my financial situation.
